QUOTE: "**allow** (`PermissionManager::is_allowed`): a match skips the prompt. It does not grant execution past a deny match, because deny is checked again in `execute`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says allow only skips the approval prompt and does not grant execution. Its flow diagram puts the allow check (`is_explicitly_allowed`) inside `check_approval` in `ToolExecutor`, while the deny check sits in `ServerManager::execute`.
